select
    nct_id,
    name                     as country,
    coalesce(removed, false) as removed   -- true = country was dropped from the record later
from "aact"."raw"."countries"

select
    nct_id,
    downcase_mesh_term as mesh_term,
    mesh_type                       -- 'mesh-list' (direct) or 'mesh-ancestor' (broader parent)
from "aact"."raw"."browse_conditions"

select
    nct_id,
    registered_in_calendar_year as registration_year,
    number_of_facilities,
    has_us_facility,
    has_single_facility,
    
    case lower(minimum_age_unit)
        when 'year'   then minimum_age_num * 1.0
        when 'month'  then minimum_age_num / 12.0
        when 'week'   then minimum_age_num / 52.0
        when 'day'    then minimum_age_num / 365.0
        when 'hour'   then minimum_age_num / 8760.0
        when 'minute' then minimum_age_num / 525600.0
    end
 as min_age_years,
    
    case lower(maximum_age_unit)
        when 'year'   then maximum_age_num * 1.0
        when 'month'  then maximum_age_num / 12.0
        when 'week'   then maximum_age_num / 52.0
        when 'day'    then maximum_age_num / 365.0
        when 'hour'   then maximum_age_num / 8760.0
        when 'minute' then maximum_age_num / 525600.0
    end
 as max_age_years
from "aact"."raw"."calculated_values"

select
    nct_id,
    upper(allocation)         as allocation,
    upper(intervention_model) as intervention_model,
    upper(primary_purpose)    as primary_purpose,
    upper(masking)            as masking
from "aact"."raw"."designs"

select
    nct_id,
    upper(gender)       as gender,
    healthy_volunteers,
    length(criteria)    as criteria_length
from "aact"."raw"."eligibilities"

select
    nct_id,
    name                         as sponsor_name,
    upper(agency_class)          as agency_class,
    lower(lead_or_collaborator)  as sponsor_role   -- 'lead' or 'collaborator'
from "aact"."raw"."sponsors"

select
    nct_id,
    upper(intervention_type) as intervention_type
from "aact"."raw"."interventions"

select
    nct_id,
    upper(overall_status)   as overall_status,
    upper(study_type)       as study_type,
    upper(phase)            as phase,
    enrollment,
    enrollment_type,
    cast(start_date as date)      as start_date,
    cast(completion_date as date) as completion_date,
    number_of_arms,
    has_dmc
from "aact"."raw"."studies"

-- The modeling population plus the label. Defined once, reused everywhere.
select
    nct_id,
    overall_status,
    study_type,
    enrollment,
    start_date,
    completion_date,
    overall_status in ('TERMINATED', 'WITHDRAWN') as at_risk
from "aact"."main"."stg_studies"
where study_type = 'INTERVENTIONAL'
  and overall_status in ('COMPLETED', 'TERMINATED', 'WITHDRAWN')

-- Collapses the four one-to-many tables to exactly one row per trial.

with sponsor_agg as (
    select
        nct_id,
        max(sponsor_name) filter (where sponsor_role = 'lead')  as lead_sponsor_name,
        max(agency_class) filter (where sponsor_role = 'lead')  as lead_agency_class,
        count(*) filter (where sponsor_role = 'collaborator')   as n_collaborators
    from "aact"."main"."stg_sponsors"
    group by nct_id
),

intervention_agg as (
    select
        nct_id,
        -- e.g. ['DRUG','PLACEBO','DRUG'] -> 'DRUG|PLACEBO'
        array_to_string(list_sort(list_distinct(list(intervention_type))), '|') as intervention_types,
        count(*) as n_interventions
    from "aact"."main"."stg_interventions"
    group by nct_id
),

country_agg as (
    select
        nct_id,
        count(distinct country) filter (where not removed) as n_countries
    from "aact"."main"."stg_countries"
    group by nct_id
),

-- Top-level MeSH disease headings -> one therapeutic area per trial.
-- priority breaks ties when a trial touches several areas (lower wins).
area_map as (
    select * from (values
        ('neoplasms',                                              'oncology',         1),
        ('cardiovascular diseases',                                'cardiovascular',   2),
        ('infections',                                             'infectious',       3),
        ('bacterial infections and mycoses',                       'infectious',       3),
        ('virus diseases',                                         'infectious',       3),
        ('parasitic diseases',                                     'infectious',       3),
        ('mental disorders',                                       'mental_health',    4),
        ('nervous system diseases',                                'neurology',        5),
        ('respiratory tract diseases',                             'respiratory',      6),
        ('digestive system diseases',                              'digestive',        7),
        ('nutritional and metabolic diseases',                     'metabolic',        8),
        ('endocrine system diseases',                              'endocrine',        9),
        ('immune system diseases',                                 'immune',          10),
        ('musculoskeletal diseases',                               'musculoskeletal', 11),
        ('skin and connective tissue diseases',                    'skin',            12),
        ('eye diseases',                                           'eye',             13),
        ('urogenital diseases',                                    'urogenital',      14),
        ('female urogenital diseases and pregnancy complications', 'urogenital',      14),
        ('male urogenital diseases',                               'urogenital',      14),
        ('hemic and lymphatic diseases',                           'blood',           15),
        ('wounds and injuries',                                    'injury',          16)
    ) as t(mesh_term, mesh_area, priority)
),

mesh_agg as (
    select
        b.nct_id,
        arg_min(a.mesh_area, a.priority) as mesh_area   -- area with the lowest priority number
    from "aact"."main"."stg_browse_conditions" b
    join area_map a on b.mesh_term = a.mesh_term
    group by b.nct_id
)

select
    s.nct_id,
    sp.lead_sponsor_name,
    sp.lead_agency_class,
    coalesce(sp.n_collaborators, 0) as n_collaborators,
    iv.intervention_types,
    coalesce(iv.n_interventions, 0) as n_interventions,
    coalesce(co.n_countries, 0)     as n_countries,
    m.mesh_area
from "aact"."main"."stg_studies" s
left join sponsor_agg      sp using (nct_id)
left join intervention_agg iv using (nct_id)
left join country_agg      co using (nct_id)
left join mesh_agg         m  using (nct_id)

-- For each trial: the lead sponsor's stop rate among its trials that ENDED
-- BEFORE this trial STARTED. Only the past is used, so no leakage.

with cohort as (
    select
        c.nct_id,
        a.lead_sponsor_name,
        c.start_date,
        c.completion_date,
        c.at_risk
    from "aact"."main"."int_cohort" c
    join "aact"."main"."int_trial_aggregates" a using (nct_id)
    where a.lead_sponsor_name is not null
),

-- Running totals per sponsor, ordered by end date. Trials sharing an end date
-- get the same totals (the default window frame includes ties), and DISTINCT
-- keeps one row per (sponsor, end date).
ended as (
    select distinct
        lead_sponsor_name,
        completion_date            as end_date,
        count(*)          over w   as n_ended_so_far,
        sum(at_risk::int) over w   as n_stopped_so_far
    from cohort
    where completion_date is not null
    window w as (partition by lead_sponsor_name order by completion_date)
)

-- ASOF join: for each trial, take the latest row in `ended` for the same
-- sponsor whose end_date is strictly before this trial's start_date.
select
    c.nct_id,
    coalesce(e.n_ended_so_far, 0)                  as sponsor_prior_n,
    e.n_stopped_so_far::double / e.n_ended_so_far  as sponsor_prior_stop_rate  -- null if no history
from cohort c
asof left join ended e
    on  c.lead_sponsor_name = e.lead_sponsor_name
    and c.start_date > e.end_date

-- One row per trial in the cohort. Everything downstream reads this table.
select
    -- id, label, and cohort columns (NOT model inputs)
    c.nct_id,
    c.at_risk,
    c.overall_status,
    c.study_type,
    c.enrollment,
    cv.registration_year,                -- split key

    -- design
    st.phase,
    d.allocation,
    d.intervention_model,
    d.primary_purpose,
    d.masking,
    st.number_of_arms,
    st.has_dmc,

    -- eligibility
    e.gender,
    e.healthy_volunteers,
    cv.min_age_years,
    cv.max_age_years,
    e.criteria_length,

    -- sites and geography
    cv.number_of_facilities,
    cv.has_us_facility,
    cv.has_single_facility,
    a.n_countries,

    -- sponsor
    a.lead_sponsor_name,
    a.lead_agency_class,
    a.n_collaborators,
    sh.sponsor_prior_n,
    sh.sponsor_prior_stop_rate,

    -- condition and intervention
    a.mesh_area,
    a.intervention_types,
    a.n_interventions

from "aact"."main"."int_cohort" c
join      "aact"."main"."stg_studies"           st using (nct_id)
left join "aact"."main"."stg_calculated_values" cv using (nct_id)
left join "aact"."main"."stg_designs"           d  using (nct_id)
left join "aact"."main"."stg_eligibilities"     e  using (nct_id)
left join "aact"."main"."int_trial_aggregates"  a  using (nct_id)
left join "aact"."main"."int_sponsor_history"   sh using (nct_id)

select nct_id
from "aact"."main"."mart_trial_analysis"
where nct_id is null

with all_values as (

    select
        overall_status as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "aact"."main"."mart_trial_analysis"
    group by overall_status

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'COMPLETED','TERMINATED','WITHDRAWN'
)

-- A singular test FAILS if it returns any rows.
-- Returns a row when at_risk has fewer than 2 distinct values.
select count(distinct at_risk) as n_values
from "aact"."main"."mart_trial_analysis"
having count(distinct at_risk) < 2

select at_risk
from "aact"."main"."mart_trial_analysis"
where at_risk is null

select
    nct_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "aact"."main"."mart_trial_analysis"
where nct_id is not null
group by nct_id
having count(*) > 1
